2607.02927.title: VideoSearcher: Empowering Video Deep Research with Multi-Tool Agentic Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
2607.02927.paper_summary: Video understanding is moving beyond closed-context perception toward open-world evidence exploration, a paradigm formalized as Video Deep Research (VDR). However, existing multimodal search agents primarily target static images, and the current VDR benchmark relies on text-centric retrieval that discards crucial visual information. To address these limitations, we propose VideoSearcher, a closed-loop agentic framework that empowers Vision-Language Models with multi-tool reasoning for VDR. VideoSearcher unifies temporal localization, spatial focusing, and multimodal search within a single reasoning trajectory, enabling agents to progressively ground visual clues, retrieve relevant evidence, and synthesize answers. To optimize knowledge-intensive reasoning trajectories, we propose Bi-branch Sequence Policy Optimization (BiSPO), a reinforcement learning algorithm that decouples tool-invocation optimization from answer-accuracy optimization. This design provides stable learning signals for both evidence-grounded reasoning and purposeful tool use. Furthermore, we construct VideoSearch-QA, the first benchmark designed to evaluate open-world video information grounding and multimodal search-based reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VideoSearcher significantly outperforms prior open-source agentic baselines across various search-oriented and multimodal understanding benchmarks.
2607.02927.paper_summary_zh: 視頻理解正在從封閉上下文的感知轉向開放世界的證據探索，這一範式被正式化為視頻深度研究（Video Deep Research，VDR）。然而，現有的多模態搜索代理主要針對靜態圖像，而當前的VDR基準依賴於以文本為中心的檢索，這忽略了關鍵的視覺信息。為了應對這些限制，我們提出了VideoSearcher，一個閉環代理框架，賦予視覺-語言模型多工具推理的能力以進行VDR。VideoSearcher在單一推理軌跡中統一了時間定位、空間聚焦和多模態搜索，使代理能夠逐步基於視覺線索進行定位、檢索相關證據並綜合答案。為了優化知識密集型推理軌跡，我們提出了雙分支序列策略優化（Bi-branch Sequence Policy Optimization，BiSPO），這是一種強化學習算法，將工具調用優化與答案準確性優化解耦。這一設計為證據基礎推理和有目的的工具使用提供了穩定的學習信號。此外，我們構建了VideoSearch-QA，這是第一個旨在評估開放世界視頻信息基礎和基於多模態搜索的推理的基準。大量實驗表明，VideoSearcher在各種面向搜索和多模態理解的基準上顯著超越了先前的開源代理基線。
